title: rumex acetosa var. nivalis
intro: Rumex acetosa var. nivalis, commonly known as White Sorrel or Alpine Sorrel, is a variety of the perennial herbaceous plant Rumex acetosa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and gout. The therapeutic actions of Rumex acetosa var. nivalis include its ability to act as a diuretic, astringent, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
